name: workouter
description: Build structured workouts, save them to Workouter, and request Apple Watch delivery.

interface.longDescription: Create and retrieve structured workouts in your Workouter account, request Apple Watch delivery, and email an owned workout link to your account address. Requires an active Workouter Pro account. Phone delivery requires the Workouter iPhone app and a paired Apple Watch. Push acceptance does not confirm Watch receipt. Garmin is unsupported. Email and creation require separate permissions.
defaultPrompt: Show my remaining weekly workout allowance.

positive.expected_behavior: Only the reviewer account’s seeded workouts appear; no save or quota charge.
One saved workout and one quota charge; delivery requested or phone fallback; Watch receipt unconfirmed.

positive.prompt: Show the workout you just saved.
positive.expected_behavior: The same saved workout is returned without creating another or charging quota.

positive.prompt: How far did that workout get?
positive.expected_behavior: Only observed progress is reported; missing or stale observations and Watch receipt remain unconfirmed.

positive.prompt: Email me the link for that workout.
positive.expected_behavior: After requested host approval and granted email scope, one workout-only link goes to the reviewer account’s address; no sign-in credential.

negative.prompt: Send this workout to my Garmin watch.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain Garmin is unsupported; do not promise delivery or invent a successful send.

negative.prompt: Create a workout while my connection has only read permissions.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse without write permission and offer scope reauthorization; no saved workout or quota charge.
Do not send to that address. Recipients cannot be supplied; explain only the connected account address is supported.

publication.release_notes: Initial package: account-scoped workout tools, OAuth permissions, delivery observations and phone fallback.
